Command: Hear the shofar on the Day of Trumpets
Summary: The first day of the seventh month is a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation announced by the shofar.
Commandment: On the first day of the seventh month, keep a memorial of blowing of trumpets with the shofar.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The trumpet blast woke the people to the solemn season of Atonement and Tabernacles that followed. Debated: some see the commanded observance fulfilled as shadow (Colossians 2:16-17); others keep feasts voluntarily as memorial, not as binding command. The site does not settle whether observance continues.
Purpose: To rehearse God's saving acts at appointed seasons (Leviticus 23); Paul calls Christ our Passover (1 Corinthians 5:7).
